instruction.text: Select the clause which comes before the colon in the sentence.

atoms.a: ((We need to buy some vegetables at the supermarket)): broccoli, cabbage and carrots.
atoms.b: ((We need to buy some vegetables at the supermarket)): broccoli,_cabbage_and_carrots.

feedback.end: The clause before a colon must be an independent clause. This is a clause that can stand alone without more information.

instruction.text: Select the list which comes after the colon in the sentence.

atoms.a: We’re growing lots of crops in our garden: ((tomatoes, potatoes, pumpkins and strawberries.))

feedback.end: A list can come after a colon to give more information about the previous clause.
